sentences.text: Yes, the 2023 circular on Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts was withdrawn with immediate effect on 2025-11-28.
The related 2023 extension circular for penal charges in loan accounts was also withdrawn with immediate effect on 2025-11-28.
As of 2026-11-23, that 2023 penal-charges circular is no longer in force.
